tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ Implement DB-GAP-66 acceptance criteria: idempotent receipt ingestion and quarantine on conflicting reuse; bounded closed receipt shape with safe opaque refs only and no prompts/transcripts/tool args/results/paths; honest counter availability and measurement; claim-boundary field; live queries for skill exposure versus activation and session counters with coverage. Add tests and verify the live ingest/query path.: Implementation is in worktree /home/kara/worktrees/duckbrain-DB-GAP-66 (commits 220f07ca + b3c940ea); the main checkout only carries the .gitreins/tasks.yaml status flip. (1) Idempotency/quarantine: src/receipts/sessionActivityReceipt.ts:600-660 — observationHash = sha256(canonicalStringify(receipt)); same receipt_id + same hash -> status "duplicate" with no second row; same id + different hash -> payload-free quarantine row (reason "conflicting_observation", only payload_sha256) and the original is never overwritten; index rebuilt from disk on restart (loadIndex, :516). (2) Bounded closed shape: SessionActivityReceiptSchema .strict() with MAX_RECEIPT_BYTES=64KB, MAX_SKILLS_PER_RECEIPT=256, 10MB segments; OPAQUE_REF_RE /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,255}$/ excludes / \ and whitespace so a ref cannot be a path; FORBIDDEN_KEY_NAMES (prompt/transcript/tool_arguments/tool_results/path/...) + SAFE_KEY_RE scan the raw payload before zod (scanPayloadKeysAndValues :320-370); FORBIDDEN_VALUE_PATTERNS reject absolute/home/relative/Windows paths, backslashes, URLs and multi-line text. (3) Counters: CounterSchema discriminated union observed(exact|floor)/heuristic(floor only)/unavailable(value null) — heuristic+exact and unavailable+numeric are rejected, omitted counters stay omitted (never zero). (4) Claim boundary: ClaimBoundarySchema requires four z.literal(true) flags (not_execution/verification/review/merge evidence); a false flag fails validation (tested at receipts-dbgap066.test.ts:218-228 -> 422 invalid_shape). (5) Live queries: querySkillExposure (:800-826) returns exposed/not_exposed/exposure_unknown and activated/not_activated/activation_unknown plus receipts_mentioning/sessions_observed; querySessionCounters (:745-790) returns per-receipt counters plus coverage {observed,heuristic,unavailable,omitted} per counter name. (6) Live path: src/http/routes/receipts.ts mounted at /api/receipts in src/cli/http.ts (POST 201/200/409/422, GET /skill/:ref, GET /session/:ref 404 when unobserved, GET / docs). (7) Tests: src/receipts/sessionActivityReceipt.test.ts (549 lines, 30+ cases incl. forbidden key/value, unsafe keys, byte/array bounds, counter arms, claim boundary, both queries, segment rotation, torn line) and src/http/routes/receipts-dbgap066.test.ts (269 lines, real createHttpServer + HTTP requests). Command evidence: `npx vitest run src/receipts/sessionActivityReceipt.test.ts src/http/routes/receipts-dbgap066.test.ts` -> exit_code 0, "Test Files 2 passed (2) / Tests 48 passed (48)"; broader `npx vitest run src/receipts src/http/routes` -> exit_code 0, "Test Files 55 passed (55) / Tests 425 passed (425)"; `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` -> exit_code 0, no diagnostics.
DB-GAP-66 is fully implemented in the DB-GAP-66 worktree with a closed opaque-ref receipt schema, key/value rejection of prompts/transcripts/tool args/results/paths, availability+measurement counters, in-band claim boundary, idempotent ingest with conflicting-reuse quarantine, live skill-exposure and session-coverage queries over HTTP, and 48 passing tests (425 across the touched suites) with a clean tsc run.
